content.title: The Carnage World
content.body:
You probably shouldn't go another dimension without any upgrades to your gear!
    §lArmor:
    §l- Furor:
    1. Tortoiseshell: Crafted using §otortoise scales§r, dropped by the §oGiant Tortoise §rin dungeons, or §oIkas §rin the ocean.
    2. Bull: Made with craftable materials.
    §l- Devout:
    1. Inquisition: Upgrade of §oplatinum §rand §ogold §rarmor.
    2. Swine: Crafted with §oPlagued Hide§r, dropped by the §oUndead Swine §rmob.
    §l- Tremor: 
    1. Hepatizon: Crafted using an §oalloy §rof §oInfuscolium §r(Found in the Deep Caverns, §oY = 5-64§r).
    2. Quicksilver: Made with an §oalloy §rof §oAstral Silver §r(Found in the Deep Caverns, §oY = 192-256§r).
    §l- Arcum:
    1. Deep Iron: Ore found in the §oDeep Caverns §rat §oY = 64-128§r.
    2. Spider: Made with craftable materials.
    §lMisc:
    - Lunch Box: craftable using king's emblem
